newsitem.title: THAILAND: PTT Exploration makes new gas find at Muda-4 well.
newsitem.headline: PTT Exploration makes new gas find at Muda-4 well.

text.p: PTT Exploration and Production Plc on Thursday said it discovered a new gas find at the Muda-4 well in the Thai-Malaysian Joint Development Area.
The tests yielded a combined gas flow rate of 18.4 million standard cubic feet per day and 122 barrels per day of condensate, a company statement said.
The appraisal drilling of the well, which is located in Block B-17 in the JDA, was conducted by Carigali-PTTEPI Operating Company Sendirian Berhad (CPOC).

Muda-4 well was spudded on January 31 this year and was drilled to test hydrocarbon potential. It is located about 265 km (160 miles) off Thailand's southern province of Songkhla and 174 km (104 miles) off Malaysia's Kota Bharu.
Preliminary negotiation on gas sales was underway with Thailand's state-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand, PTTEP's parent company, PTT Exploration and Production said.
